admission.justification: The members jointly preserve the user-controlled installation boundary across code, state reporting and agent-launch behavior; no individual local guard or notice prevents both wrong-root mutations and a misleading recovery/launch contract.

guarantee: A supported host launch suppresses exactly the ambient product tools while retaining the bound task server and existing user deny policy; unsupported pinned-provider cases remain explicit per-agent exceptions with the protective task-server instruction. The supplied-map filter and carried configuration root keep the generated task server on the selected host, without writing user/harness configuration.
title: Truthful per-launch product-tool policy without changing user configuration
